$comment: Delivery profiles for plan-changeset. Pick one before planning; it sets how much proof the work needs. A prototype that ships 2,000 tests is waste; a production change with one smoke test is a risk. scripts/overengineering-index.mjs --profile checks a plan against max_index. Moving a prototype to production does not backfill old commits: one retroactive-attestation receipt covers the prototype range (references/chain-receipt-contract.md). conditional_stages lists which triggered conditional stages a profile keeps ("all" keeps every one); scripts/stage-activation.mjs --profile marks the rest deferred.

prototype.goal: Prove the idea works end to end and learn fast. Throwaway is fine.
prototype.use_when: Spikes, demos, hackathons, 'does this even work', anything not yet used by real users.
prototype.tests: A smoke test for the happy path of each AC. No coverage target, no edge-case matrix.
prototype.chain: Essential stages only, plus a conditional stage when it is mechanically triggered AND risk is high (auth, money, data loss).
prototype.review: Self-review. One independent review only for auth, payments or data deletion.
prototype.receipts: Quick receipt per commit. No backfill. Promotion to mvp or production is one range attestation, not per-commit receipts.

mvp.goal: Real users, small scale: works reliably on the main paths and is easy to change.
mvp.use_when: First release to real users, internal tools, features behind a flag.
mvp.tests: One test per AC, a regression test per fixed bug, and the critical user journey end to end.
mvp.chain: Essential stages plus conditional stages the plan or diff mechanically triggers.
mvp.review: Independent review of plan and implementation.
mvp.receipts: Full receipt envelope on merges to main. Gaps are covered by one range attestation when an audit needs them, never by replaying stages.

production.goal: Many users or money or data at stake: correct, observable, reversible.
production.use_when: Paid products, regulated data, anything a rollback would hurt.
production.tests: AC tests, edge cases and failure paths, journeys/E2E for critical paths, and the repo's coverage gate.
production.chain: Full chain from the stage registry for the story type, with every conditional stage evaluated.
production.review: Full chain with cross-family independent review.
production.receipts: Full envelope on every pushed commit; enforce mode when the owner sets it.
